title: Visualization Fidelity Atlas Bundle
source_documents: Picking the Right Visualization - Why Pie Charts are Undesirable.md
Below is a research-grounded version of the argument.md

interaction_contract.selection: Visual-form selection, exemplar selection, and Reserved-group visibility remain distinct, visible states. Every exemplar action names its exact example and position, and pressed state identifies the current example.
interaction_contract.exchange: Paste and local-file routes share one size-limited interactive-render validation and commit path. Renderable collections, closed references, and finite chart values are checked; schema-optional recommendation scores appear as Not scored.
interaction_contract.rendering: Accepted Atlas strings remain inert text in controls, HTML, and SVG output.
interaction_contract.recovery: A rejected import leaves the last accepted Atlas and view state active.
interaction_contract.prompt_capsule: The authored no-script plain Markdown and the interactive plain and skill-assisted views follow prompt-capsule/0.1.0. Each view carries the complete public Atlas record, exactly eight selection values that can change the result, human-held decisions, a requested return, evidence and recovery, and two conditionally useful collaboration loops.
interaction_contract.copy: Visible Prompt Capsule Markdown, clipboard output, downloaded Markdown, and the public API expose the same bytes for the selected view. Atlas JSON and JSON-LD remain separately selectable structured twins.
interaction_contract.fingerprint: A deterministic FNV-1a UTF-8 fingerprint covers the key-canonicalized public Atlas and its eight selection values together with stable capsule identity. Markdown-view choice, interface status, clipboard state, and compatible private extensions retain their own roles outside that fingerprint.
interaction_contract.extensions: Compatible root and nested Atlas extensions survive accepted JSON import and export while the public Prompt Capsule projects the fields authored by this Atlas version.
interaction_contract.api: The frozen visualizationFidelityAtlas API returns detached state and routes API imports through the same validated atomic commit and retained-state recovery path as visitor imports.
interaction_contract.semantic_twin: The selected form, exemplar, visible controls, JSON export, JSON-LD graph, and Prompt Capsule are rebuilt from the accepted Atlas and current selection.
